leadText:
Pokémon Quiz (Japanese: Pokémon Quiz) is a question-and-answer segment used in the Japanese and Korean versions of Pokémon the Series: XY, as opposed to the Who's That Pokémon? segment used in the English dub.

Each Pokémon Quiz starts by featuring the silhouette of a Pokémon on a large card. Then, to the right, four smaller cards with silhouettes appear. One card has a silhouette identical to the first, two have silhouettes of similar Pokémon species, and the remaining has the silhouette of . The objective is for the viewers to find the matching card and remember its location. After the commercial break, the quiz reveals the solution, as well as the identities of the Pokémon species silhouetted.

==Trivia==

In XY010, two cards presenting Piplup and Oshawott below right to Chespin and Team Rocket decoy cards are likely a reference to and .
XY051 and XY079 are the only episodes that don't present the Team Rocket decoy card.
XY078 is the only episode not to feature this segment.
